page.overview:
What is Adventure Phantom Balloon Boy?

, commonly referred to as Adventure Phantom BB, is an unlockable character in FNaF World.

Phantom BB's appearance is almost identical to his core series counterpart, but he is smaller. Like all of the Phantom animatronics, his eyes are white dots surrounded by white rings. Like his core series counterpart, he is missing his iconic balloons and sign.

Phantom BB has very similar attacks as Adventure Phantom Freddy. Unlike Adventure Phantom Freddy, however, he is not purely stat-based, and can do damage with Toxic Balloon, which poisons a single enemy. He can also lower a single enemies' attack power with Gloom Balloon, and all enemies defense with Rainy Day.
